title: The Effect of Integrated CAM Treatment in Hospitalized Patients
brief_summary: This study investigates the effect of hospital-based intensive non-surgical treatment in musculoskeletal patients admitted to an integrated hospital that offers both complementary and alternative medicine (CAM) and conventional medicine treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients hospitalized due to spine or joint diseases

Exclusion Criteria:

* Main complaint other than back pain, radiating leg pain, neck pain, radiating arm pain, knee pain or shoulder pain
* Cause of pain non-related to spine, joint or soft tissue; for example, spinal tumors, pregnancy, urolithiasis, etc.
* Refusal to provide the information needed for clinical research
study_population: Musculoskeletal patients admitted to an integrated hospital that offers both complementary and alternative medicine (CAM) and conventional medicine treatment.
